      public ReportingServiceImpl(TradeReportingRepository repository, Clock clock, org.springframework.core.io.ResourceLoader resourceLoader)
      Creates the reporting service.
      Parameters:
      repository - existing read-only reporting repository used by the dashboard insights endpoints
      clock - UTC-aware clock used to derive the current day window
      resourceLoader - classpath resource loader used to read the BR-16 CSV dataset
